entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-10-29
entry.content:
Azure.AI.AgentServer.Invocations_1.0.0-beta.8

1.0.0-beta.8 (2026-10-28)

Features Added

  • Added VoiceInputDataPart, ordered VoiceUserMessageEvent.ContentParts, and VoiceResponseOutputDataDoneMessage for application data in Bridge protocol 1.0. The existing text-only Content projection and explicit silent completion remain available.
  • Added a standalone /voice_conversation_engine WebSocket route for typed Voice
    handlers registered with AddVoice<THandler>(). It reuses the existing Bridge
    Protocol 1.0 relay alongside /invocations_ws, without new registration options
    or changes to generic Invocations handlers.
  • Aligned the experimental Voice caller-interruption contract with user.barge_in, VoiceUserBargeInEvent, and OnUserBargeInAsync, preserving playback snapshots and application-owned cancellation/history. Voice Live senders must use the same event contract. Generic raw WebSocket handlers are unchanged.

Other Changes

  • Reference the published Azure.AI.AgentServer.Core 1.0.0-beta.30 package instead of the current Core project, so this release does not require publishing Core 1.0.0-beta.31.
  • Updated resilient task samples to call SetResilientTasksEnabled() explicitly; task
    registration alone no longer activates storage or recovery.
  • Updated the resilient research sample to use constructor-injected task handlers and
    task-bound producer/consumer streams, while retaining registry lookup for later GET
    replay by invocation id.

Azure.Provisioning_1.7.0-beta.2

1.7.0-beta.2 (2026-10-29)

Features Added

  • Added a typed ManagementLock.Scope property to apply a lock to an individual resource. Leaving it unset or assigning null preserves deployment-scope locking. (#63624)
  • Types deriving from ManagementLock that declare their own Scope member, such as the workaround described in the issue, now hide this property (warning CS0108). Remove that member and use ManagementLock.Scope.
  • Added support for explicitly tagged raw Bicep expressions in BicepValue<BinaryData> using the text/vnd.microsoft.bicep media type.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed null assignments to generated resource references in this library to clear the reference instead of emitting an explicit null. Clearing a required Parent leaves it unset for required-property validation.
  • Fixed BicepValue<BinaryData> literal compilation to emit JSON through Bicep's json(...) function while preserving generated base64-encoded properties.

Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.EventHubs_6.5.5

6.5.5 (2026-10-27)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where stale checkpoints could prevent scale-in when BatchCheckpointFrequency was greater than 1. Pending processed events are now checkpointed after 10 minutes of inactivity so that the scale controller does not report backlog for events that have already been processed. (#59801)

Azure.ResourceManager.Storage_1.9.0

1.9.0 (2026-10-28)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version from 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-01. Tag details available at https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/tree/fd6b671904429f73310b882648f81346b05024d1/specification/storage/resource-manager/Microsoft.Storage/Storage.
    • Supported new BlobAccessPointConfigurationResource for managing Blob Access Point configurations and testing proposed and existing connections to backing data stores.
    • Supported attaching blob containers to Blob Access Point configurations and enabling Blob Access Points through StorageDataCollaborationPolicyProperties.AllowBlobAccessPoints.
    • Supported new TurboTier configuration on storage account create/update, including status and target percentage.
    • Supported context cache name availability checks.
    • Supported new ServiceTags property on NspAccessRuleProperties for inbound network security perimeter access rules.

Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerService_1.10.0-beta.1

1.10.0-beta.1 (2026-10-22)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-08-02-preview.

Azure.AI.VoiceLive_1.2.1

1.2.1 (2026-10-28)

Bugs Fixed

  • WebSocket connections no longer follow redirects, preventing API keys and other handshake headers from being forwarded to redirect destinations.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Secrets_4.12.0

4.12.0 (2026-10-27)

Other Changes

  • Regenerated the library for stable Key Vault API version 2026-04-01.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Certificates_4.10.0

4.10.0 (2026-10-27)

Other Changes

  • Regenerated the library for stable Key Vault API version 2026-04-01.
